purpose: Bounded research comparison; never promote on reused development validation alone
noise_policy: declared stress bound, not claimed measured sensor calibration; shared current bearing rotation, half-correlated previous rotation
selection: Require compatible MAE <= frozen baseline *1.05, p95 <= frozen baseline*1.05; noise P95 and maximum below frozen baseline; reject missing export or nonfinite outputs. Rank eligible by noise P95, then worst-group MAE. Repeat only winner without changing chosen seed.
